result.note: Short item on a maritime attack; only the location of the incident is a durable places-in-the-news fact worth testing.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, a projectile struck the MT On Peace, injuring 11 Indian sailors. In which strait did the attack take place?
questions.explain: The MT On Peace was hit in the Strait of Hormuz on 7 October 2026, injuring 11 Indian sailors. It was the second attack on an Indian-crewed vessel off Oman in under a month.
questions.source: A projectile struck the MT On Peace in the Strait of Hormuz, injuring 11 Indian sailors, the second attack on an Indian-crewed vessel off Oman in under a month.
